description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain reference functionality, including serialization, equality, comparison, and interning of grain references, as well as testing passing references between grains and handling null references.

classes.name: GrainReferenceTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans grain reference behaviors such as equality, serialization, and interning.

classes.name: GenericGrainReferenceHolder
classes.description: A serializable container class for holding a GrainReference, used in JSON serialization tests.

methods.name: GrainReferenceComparison_ShouldProduceUniformHashCode
methods.description: Tests that grain references produce a consistent hash code.

methods.name: GrainReferenceComparison_DifferentReference
methods.description: Tests that different grain references are properly distinguished.

methods.name: GrainReference_Pass_this
methods.description: Tests passing a grain's own reference to another grain.

methods.name: GrainReference_Pass_this_Nested
methods.description: Tests passing grain references within nested data structures.

methods.name: GrainReference_Json_Serialization
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of grain references.

methods.name: GrainReference_Json_Serialization_Nested
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of grain references within complex objects.

methods.name: GrainReference_Json_Serialization_Unresolved
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of unresolved grain references.

methods.name: GrainReference_Interning_Sys_StoreGrain
methods.description: Tests interning behavior for system grain references (currently skipped).

methods.name: TestGrainReferenceSerialization
methods.description: Helper method to test serialization of grain references with optional resolution before serialization.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonSerializeRoundtrip
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object using Newtonsoft.Json to test round-trip integrity.
